name: cash.notional_pool_reports

list.description: Read native notional cash pool report rows without business operations.

parameters.name: end-date
parameters.description: Inclusive source value-date end, YYYY-MM-DD; earlier than one calendar month after start.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: Explicit native source timezone; currently qualified GMT+08.

summary: Native notional cash pool closing-balance report records.
purpose: Inspect recorded notional pool/account/currency/value-date balances for an explicit date and timezone scope.

fields.name: id
fields.meaning: Native source id, retained even when blank; not the primary identity.

fields.name: cashPoolName
fields.meaning: Native named cash pool membership dimension; distinct pools remain separate records.

fields.name: aliasName
fields.meaning: Native account-alias identity dimension within the selected pool/currency/value date.

fields.name: cashPoolType
fields.meaning: Native row field retained even when blank; request scope fixes Notional_Cash_Pool.

fields.name: valueDate
fields.meaning: Native report value date in source format and selected timezone.

fields.name: transDate
fields.meaning: Native transaction date, distinct from value date.

fields.name: amount
fields.meaning: Native decimal amount text; currency and direction remain separate.

fields.name: closingBalance
fields.meaning: Native recorded closing balance text; not current available cash.

identity_description: Reviewed native pool/account-alias/currency/value-date tuple identifies one notional balance observation; balance updates retain identity. Native id is retained even when blank.
limitations: Only Notional_Cash_Pool; dates and qualified GMT+08 source timezone are explicit per acquisition.
List only; no pool configuration, report edits, per-row details or other business actions.
Source totalAmount metadata is preserved per page with its native scope; never recalculated or relabeled as cash balance.

Existing SDK composite identity uses exactly cashPoolName, aliasName, currency and valueDate without adding a synthetic field or using mutable balance values. This identity is not shared with Physical/Sweeping transaction reports.
Native report rows are request-range dependent; a wide saved capture does not establish all daily observations or reproduce a narrower native query through local date filtering.
